
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Can-daydayup/p/20958904" title="发布于 2026-06-30 13:04">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一套基于 .NET 10 + Vue 3 构建、高颜值、前后端分离的企业级多租户中后台管理系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>前言</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>做后台管理系统，总逃不过重复造轮子：每次新项目都要重搭登录、权限等基础功能，权限控制补丁越打越多，多租户实现更是牵一发而动全身。今天大姚给大家分享一套基于 .NET 10 + Vue 3 构建、开源（MIT License）、高颜值、前后端分离的企业级多租户中后台管理系统：<strong>XiHan.BasicApp</strong><span>。</span></span></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目介绍</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>XiHan.BasicApp 是一套基于 .NET 10 + Vue 3 构建、开源（MIT License）、高颜值、前后端分离的企业级多租户中后台管理系统。后端遵循 DDD（领域驱动设计）分层与 CQRS（命令查询职责分离）模式，应用服务经动态 API 直接暴露为 REST 接口；前端使用 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Naive UI，提供了现代化的用户界面和良好的开发体验。系统内置了完整的身份、权限、租户与审计能力，既可作为中后台项目的起点，也可作为 .NET + Vue 全栈实践的参考。</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130006086-1852558026.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>适用人群</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>想要一套"权限和多租户是真做了"的中后台起步模板，而不是又一个换皮的 admin；</span></li>
<li><span>正啃 .NET + Vue 全栈开发，想看看 DDD/CQRS、动态 API、RBAC+ABAC 这些概念如何落地成代码；</span></li>
<li><span>在搞 B2B SaaS 产品，需要租户隔离、套餐版本管理、权限白名单这些硬核功能一站式搞定。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>核心功能模块</span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>用户管理模块</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>支持用户的注册、登录、权限分配与角色管理。多种登录方式：账号密码、邮箱 / 短信验证码、OAuth2（GitHub / Google / QQ）、2FA（TOTP / 邮箱 / 短信）。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130021678-976504085.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130026682-1537938697.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130032230-454984761.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130042372-350098435.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130048386-1450604468.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>RBAC权限控制模块</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>角色层级继承（闭包表）、数据范围（本人 / 部门 / 租户）、字段级脱敏，确保数据的安全性与合规性。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130101223-36145158.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130107429-19345361.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>租户管理模块</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>针对多租户场景，提供租户的创建、配置与管理功能。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130122682-1485799405.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130127592-1565176027.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>代码生成模块</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>单表 / 树形 / 主从三种模式，从实体、DTO、API 到前端页面一键生成，提高开发效率，减少重复劳动。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130143049-1548270399.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130148018-769808859.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130154206-795460939.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>审计日志模块</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>访问 / API / 操作 / 异常 / 登录 / 实体变更 六类日志，各自独立写入。</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130245389-1399849484.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130250849-809758258.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130258319-1842293252.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130303140-690996777.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>系统设置模块</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>包含菜单管理、字典管理、参数配置、任务调度、缓存管理、服务监控等。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130315930-1409131141.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130321045-310450109.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130326579-1311851866.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130331387-1224658256.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130342015-434487942.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>移动端展示</span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>很多后台的"移动端"就是把 PC 页面硬塞进小屏。XiHan.BasicApp 是按移动端交互重新做的登录、工作台、菜单、命令面板、消息中心，体验接近原生 App：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130401151-667003364.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目特点</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>高性能：</strong><span>基于 .NET 优化的高性能架构，确保应用程序高效运行。</span></li>
<li><strong>模块化：</strong><span>采用模块化设计，各组件松耦合，便于扩展和维护。</span></li>
<li><strong>易用性：</strong><span>简洁的 API 设计和丰富的约定，降低学习成本。</span></li>
<li><strong>跨平台：</strong><span>支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 等多种操作系统平台。</span></li>
<li><strong>安全性：</strong><span>内置完善的身份认证与授权体系，保障应用安全。</span></li>
<li><strong>可扩展：</strong><span>灵活的插件体系，满足各种定制化需求。</span></li>
<li><strong>DDD支持：</strong><span>原生支持领域驱动设计，便于构建复杂业务系统。</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>系统架构</span></h2>
<blockquote>
<p><span>XiHan.BasicApp 系统分为框架层、模块层与主应用层，每个模块内部遵循 DDD 分层（Domain / Application / Infrastructure）。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code><span>┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; XiHan.BasicApp.WebHost &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; (启动入口与模块聚合) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br><span>├──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┤<br><span>│ &nbsp;XiHan.BasicApp.Saas &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp;XiHan.BasicApp.CodeGeneration│<br><span>│ &nbsp;(RBAC / 多租户 / 审计) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │ &nbsp;(代码生成与模板管理) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br><span>├──────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┤<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; XiHan.BasicApp.Web.Core &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;(Web 核心能力 / 动态 API / 网关 / 灰度) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br><span>├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; XiHan.BasicApp.Core &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; (基础应用能力 / DDD / CQRS / 模块化) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br><span>├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;XiHan.Framework.* &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;│<br><span>│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 底层框架(认证 / 授权 / 数据 / 缓存 / 事件总线 / 多租户) &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; │<br><span>└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目分层</span></h2>
<div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130413485-117825336.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目技术栈</span></h2>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>后端</strong><span>：.NET 10、SqlSugar（PostgreSQL / MySQL / MariaDB）、Redis、SignalR、Serilog、Scalar。</span></li>
<li><strong>前端</strong><span>：Vue 3.5、TypeScript、Vite、Naive UI、Pinia、Tailwind CSS、Tiptap、vue-i18n。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1336199/202606/1336199-20260630130429341-434499001.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目运行</span></h2>
<pre data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code># 后端<br><span>git&nbsp;clone<span>&nbsp;https://github.com/XiHanFun/XiHan.BasicApp.git<br>cd<span>&nbsp;XiHan.BasicApp/backend<br><span>dotnet run --project src/main/XiHan.BasicApp.WebHost --launch-profile Development<br><br># 前端（另开一个终端）<br>cd<span>&nbsp;../frontend<br><span>pnpm install &amp;&amp; pnpm dev<br></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>首次启动会自动建表 + 初始化种子数据，默认管理员账号 <code>superadmin</code><span>。后端 API 文档在 <code>http://127.0.0.1:9708/scalar</code><span>。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>项目源码地址</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>更多项目实用功能和特性欢迎前往项目开源地址查看👀，别忘了给项目一个Star支持💖。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><strong>GitHub：</strong><span> https://github.com/XiHanFun/XiHan.BasicApp</span></li>
<li><strong>Gitee：</strong><span> https://gitee.com/XiHanFun/XiHan.BasicApp</span></li>
<li><strong>源码导读：</strong><span> https://deepwiki.com/XiHanFun/XiHan.BasicApp</span></li>
<li><strong>在线预览：</strong><span> https://basicapp.xihanfun.com</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>优秀项目和框架精选</span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>该项目已收录至C#/.NET/.NET Core优秀项目和框架精选中，关注该精选合集，可以及时了解C#、.NET和.NET Core领域的最新动态、优质项目与最佳实践，帮助.NET开发者提升开发效率和项目质量。欢迎大家提交 PR 推荐或自荐优秀项目（<strong>让优秀的项目和框架不被埋没🤞</strong><span>）。</span></span></p>
